sections.zh: 课题组网站、读书会与教学

projects.en: Emails you a daily list of new arXiv papers ranked by similarity to the papers already in your Zotero library, with LLM-written TL;DRs.
projects.zh: 按你 Zotero 文献库里已有论文的相似度，每天给你推荐当天新出的 arXiv 论文并附上大模型写的摘要，发到邮箱。

projects.en: Crawls chosen arXiv categories every day, summarises each paper with an LLM and publishes a browsable GitHub Pages site.
projects.zh: 每天抓取指定 arXiv 分类的新论文，用大模型逐篇总结，生成一个可浏览的 GitHub Pages 网站。

projects.en: Self-hosted arXiv browser where you tag papers you like and get recommendations of similar new papers.
projects.zh: 自建的 arXiv 浏览站点：给喜欢的论文打标签，它据此推荐相似的新论文。

projects.en: Template that keeps a Markdown table of new arXiv papers per keyword, updated daily by GitHub Actions, with code links.
projects.zh: 一个模板：按关键词每天自动更新一张 arXiv 新论文表（带代码链接），由 GitHub Actions 维护。

projects.en: Daily AI ecosystem digest merging GitHub, arXiv, Hugging Face, Hacker News and other sources into one report.
projects.zh: 把 GitHub、arXiv、Hugging Face、Hacker News 等来源合成一份每日 AI 动态简报。

projects.en: Daily arXiv and OpenReview recommendations with AI reading and paper Q&A, deployed on GitHub Pages via Actions.
projects.zh: 每天推荐 arXiv 和 OpenReview 新论文，并能用 AI 阅读和问答，通过 GitHub Actions 部署到 GitHub Pages。

projects.en: Code for Cool Papers, a fast feed of new arXiv papers and conference proceedings with one-click LLM explanations (Kimi) per paper.
projects.zh: Cool Papers 网站的代码：快速浏览 arXiv 新论文和会议论文集，每篇都可以让大模型（Kimi）讲解。

projects.en: Mobile and desktop app that follows journals' table-of-contents feeds and new articles, with open-access lookup.
projects.zh: 手机和桌面应用，订阅期刊目录更新和新文章，并查找开放获取版本。

projects.en: MCP server that lets an AI assistant search arXiv, read paper sections from the LaTeX source and fetch BibTeX.
projects.zh: MCP 服务：让 AI 助手检索 arXiv、按章节读论文 LaTeX 原文、获取 BibTeX。

projects.en: Fetches author profiles and publication data from Google Scholar from Python.
projects.zh: 用 Python 从 Google Scholar 获取作者主页和论文信息。

projects.en: Retrieval-augmented LLM that answers scientific questions with citations drawn from a 45M-paper open corpus.
projects.zh: 检索增强的大模型，从 4500 万篇开放论文中检索并带引用地回答科研问题。

projects.en: LLM agent that runs searches, reads papers and follows citations on its own to answer a detailed literature query.
projects.zh: 大模型智能体：针对一个具体的文献查询，自己检索、读论文、顺着引用找，返回相关论文列表。

projects.en: Python wrapper for the arXiv API: query, page through results and download PDFs or source.
projects.zh: arXiv API 的 Python 封装：检索、翻页、下载 PDF 或源码。

projects.en: Active-learning screening for systematic reviews: you label a few titles/abstracts, it ranks the rest by likely relevance.
projects.zh: 系统综述的主动学习筛选工具：你标几篇标题摘要，它把剩下的按相关可能性排序。

projects.en: Python client for the Semantic Scholar APIs: paper and author search, citations, references and recommendations.
projects.zh: Semantic Scholar API 的 Python 客户端：检索论文和作者、取引用与参考文献、获取推荐。

projects.en: Python client for OpenAlex: works, authors, venues and citation links with filters and paging.
projects.zh: OpenAlex 的 Python 客户端：查论文、作者、期刊会议和引用关系，支持过滤和翻页。

projects.en: Library and app behind Ai2 Scholar QA: multi-step search over Semantic Scholar that writes a sectioned, cited literature answer.
projects.zh: Ai2 Scholar QA 的代码库：在 Semantic Scholar 上多步检索，生成分节、带引用的文献综述式回答。

projects.en: Browser app that builds the citation network around a set of seed papers (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref) to find missing related work.
projects.zh: 浏览器里运行：从几篇种子论文出发，用 OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar/Crossref 构建引用网络，帮你找漏掉的相关工作。

projects.en: Desktop reference manager that collects papers from the browser, stores PDFs, annotates and inserts citations into Word/LibreOffice.
projects.zh: 桌面文献管理软件：从浏览器抓取论文、保存 PDF、做批注，并在 Word/LibreOffice 里插入引用。

projects.en: Zotero plugin that fetches metadata for Chinese papers from CNKI and fixes Chinese name and attachment issues.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：从知网抓取中文文献元数据，处理中文姓名和附件问题。

projects.en: Zotero plugin that gives stable citation keys and keeps an auto-exported .bib file in sync for LaTeX.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：生成稳定的引用键，并自动导出、同步 .bib 文件给 LaTeX 用。

projects.en: MCP server that lets AI assistants search, read and annotate your Zotero library, including semantic search.
projects.zh: MCP 服务：让 AI 助手检索、阅读和批注你的 Zotero 文献库，支持语义检索。

projects.en: Desktop manager that edits .bib/.biblatex files directly, with DOI/arXiv lookup, duplicate detection and citation-key patterns.
projects.zh: 直接编辑 .bib/.biblatex 文件的桌面文献管理器，支持按 DOI/arXiv 抓取、查重和引用键规则。

projects.en: Replaces arXiv entries in a .bib file with their published versions from DBLP and the ACL Anthology.
projects.zh: 把 .bib 中的 arXiv 条目替换为 DBLP 和 ACL Anthology 上的正式发表版本。

projects.en: Command-line document and bibliography manager that stores papers as plain folders with YAML metadata.
projects.zh: 命令行的文献和文档管理器，把论文存成普通文件夹加 YAML 元数据。

projects.en: Cleans and formats BibTeX files: sorts, removes duplicates, normalises fields; CLI and web page.
projects.zh: 整理和格式化 BibTeX 文件：排序、去重、统一字段；有命令行和网页版。

projects.en: Zotero plugin that lints and normalises item metadata: title case, journal abbreviations, languages, duplicates.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：检查并统一条目元数据，如标题大小写、期刊缩写、语言字段、重复项。

projects.en: Command-line tools that update .bib entries from Crossref/DBLP, fetch BibTeX from a DOI and sync fields.
projects.zh: 命令行工具：用 Crossref/DBLP 更新 .bib 条目、按 DOI 获取 BibTeX、同步字段。

projects.en: Converts PDFs, including formulas and tables, into Markdown/JSON for reading in other tools or feeding to an LLM.
projects.zh: 把 PDF（含公式和表格）转成 Markdown/JSON，方便在别的工具里阅读或喂给大模型。

projects.en: LLM workbench with one-click paper actions: full-text PDF/LaTeX translation, summarisation, polishing and arXiv paper reading.
projects.zh: 大模型工作台，内置论文相关功能：PDF/LaTeX 全文翻译、总结、润色、读 arXiv 论文。

projects.en: Self-hosted NotebookLM alternative: add papers and sources, chat with them, take notes, make audio overviews.
projects.zh: 自托管的 NotebookLM 替代品：导入论文等资料，与其对话、记笔记、生成播客式讲解。

projects.en: Translates scientific PDFs while keeping formulas, figures and layout, outputting a translated or side-by-side bilingual PDF.
projects.zh: 翻译科学论文 PDF，保留公式、图表和排版，输出译文版或双语对照版。

projects.en: Zotero plugin that translates selected text, annotations, titles and abstracts with 20+ engines while reading.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：阅读时划词翻译，也能翻译批注、标题和摘要，支持 20 多种翻译服务。

projects.en: Keyboard-driven PDF viewer for papers: previews references and figures on hover, smart jump, portals and searchable highlights.
projects.zh: 面向论文的键盘驱动 PDF 阅读器：悬停预览参考文献和图表、智能跳转、高亮可检索。

projects.en: Answers questions over a folder of papers with retrieval and cited, checked answers (PaperQA2).
projects.zh: 对一批论文做问答：检索后给出带引用、经核对的答案（PaperQA2）。

projects.en: Zotero plugin for linked notes, note templates, outlines and syncing notes to Markdown.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：双向链接笔记、笔记模板、大纲视图，并能把笔记同步成 Markdown。

projects.en: Zotero plugin that runs PDFMathTranslate on a paper and attaches the bilingual PDF back to the item.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：对论文调用 PDFMathTranslate，把生成的双语 PDF 挂回条目。

projects.en: Zotero plugin to chat with the open PDF or selected items using an LLM, and to summarise or tag them.
projects.zh: Zotero 插件：用大模型与当前 PDF 或选中条目对话，做总结或打标签。

projects.en: Extracts header metadata, sections and a parsed reference list from scholarly PDFs into TEI XML.
projects.zh: 从学术 PDF 中抽取题录信息、章节结构和解析后的参考文献列表，输出 TEI XML。

projects.en: Lets coding agents run many small single-GPU training experiments overnight and keep what improves the metric.
projects.zh: 让编程智能体在单卡上自动跑大量小规模训练实验，保留能提升指标的改动。

projects.en: Multi-agent harness that searches, runs code in a sandbox and writes reports for long research tasks.
projects.zh: 多智能体框架：检索、在沙箱里跑代码、撰写报告，可处理耗时较长的研究任务。

projects.en: Researches a topic and writes a Wikipedia-style survey article with citations, useful as a first map of an unfamiliar area.
projects.zh: 围绕一个主题检索资料，写出带引用的维基百科式综述，适合快速了解陌生领域。

projects.en: Deep-research agent that searches the web or your own documents and writes a cited report with any LLM provider.
projects.zh: 深度研究智能体：检索网页或本地文档，用任意大模型写出带引用的报告。

projects.en: End-to-end 'AI scientist': proposes ideas, runs experiments via agentic tree search, and drafts a workshop-style paper.
projects.zh: 端到端的“AI 科学家”：提出想法、用智能体树搜索跑实验，并写出研讨会水平的论文草稿。

projects.en: Distributed compute framework whose Ray Tune module runs hyperparameter searches in parallel across GPUs and nodes.
projects.zh: 分布式计算框架，其中 Ray Tune 能在多卡多机上并行跑超参数搜索。

projects.en: Logs parameters, metrics and artifacts of each run to a local or self-hosted server and lets you compare runs in a web UI.
projects.zh: 把每次实验的参数、指标和产物记到本地或自建服务器上，在网页里对比不同运行。

projects.en: Hyperparameter search with pruning of bad trials, a define-by-run API and a dashboard for studies.
projects.zh: 超参数搜索库，能提前剪掉差的试验，接口灵活，并有看板查看搜索过程。

projects.en: Composes experiment configs from YAML files and command-line overrides, and launches sweeps over them.
projects.zh: 用 YAML 文件和命令行覆盖组合实验配置，并能按配置批量扫参。

projects.en: Generates a standard folder layout for a data-science or research project so data, code and results stay separated.
projects.zh: 生成标准的数据科学/研究项目目录结构，让数据、代码和结果分开存放。

projects.en: Tracks experiments automatically and adds a task queue and agents so runs can be cloned and re-run on other machines.
projects.zh: 自动记录实验，并带任务队列和执行代理，可以把一次运行复制到别的机器上重跑。

projects.en: Self-hosted experiment tracker with a fast UI for querying and comparing thousands of runs and their metric curves.
projects.zh: 可自建的实验记录工具，界面能快速查询、对比成千上万次运行的指标曲线。

projects.en: Project template combining PyTorch Lightning and Hydra with logging, testing and experiment-config conventions.
projects.zh: 把 PyTorch Lightning 和 Hydra 结合好的项目模板，带日志、测试和实验配置约定。

projects.en: Lightweight experiment tracker with a W&B-like API, offline or self-hosted dashboard, popular with Chinese labs.
projects.zh: 轻量的实验记录工具，接口与 W&B 相近，可离线或自建看板，国内实验室用得多。

projects.en: Drop-in replacement for the wandb logging API that stores runs locally and can show the dashboard on a Hugging Face Space.
projects.zh: 可直接替换 wandb 记录接口，运行数据存在本地，看板可放到 Hugging Face Space 上。

projects.en: Very fast Python package and environment manager with lockfiles, making research environments quick to recreate.
projects.zh: 速度很快的 Python 包和环境管理器，带锁文件，研究环境能快速重建。

projects.en: htop-like GPU monitor that works for NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and Apple GPUs.
projects.zh: 类似 htop 的 GPU 监控，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 和苹果 GPU。

projects.en: Runs the same job YAML on any cloud, Kubernetes or Slurm cluster, picking the cheapest available GPUs and using spot instances.
projects.zh: 同一份任务 YAML 可在各家云、Kubernetes 或 Slurm 上运行，自动挑最便宜的可用 GPU，支持抢占式实例。

projects.en: Conda-ecosystem package manager with per-project lockfiles, covering CUDA and non-Python dependencies.
projects.zh: 基于 conda 生态的包管理器，按项目生成锁文件，能管 CUDA 等非 Python 依赖。

projects.en: Interactive GPU process viewer showing per-process memory, utilisation and owner, also usable as a Python library.
projects.zh: 交互式 GPU 进程查看器，显示每个进程的显存、利用率和所属用户，也可作为 Python 库调用。

projects.en: The batch job scheduler used on most university and national HPC clusters.
projects.zh: 大多数高校和国家超算集群使用的作业调度系统。

projects.en: One-line-per-GPU status of memory, utilisation and users, handy for scripts and checking who is using a shared box.
projects.zh: 每块 GPU 一行显示显存、利用率和使用者，适合脚本里用或查看共享服务器谁在占卡。

projects.en: Open-source orchestrator for dev environments, training jobs and services on clouds and on-prem GPU fleets.
projects.zh: 开源的 GPU 编排工具，在云上或自有机器上开开发环境、跑训练任务和部署服务。

projects.en: Container runtime (formerly Singularity) that runs images without root, the usual way to use containers on HPC clusters.
projects.zh: 容器运行时（原 Singularity），无需 root 即可运行镜像，是超算集群上使用容器的常见方式。

projects.en: Submits Python functions as Slurm jobs and returns results like futures, so sweeps run on a cluster from plain Python.
projects.zh: 把 Python 函数直接提交成 Slurm 作业并像 future 一样取回结果，用普通 Python 就能在集群上扫参。

projects.en: Self-hosted labelling tool for text, images, audio, video and LLM outputs with configurable annotation interfaces.
projects.zh: 可自建的标注工具，支持文本、图像、音频、视频和大模型输出，标注界面可配置。

projects.en: Annotation tool for images and video (boxes, polygons, tracks) with model-assisted labelling.
projects.zh: 图像和视频标注工具（框、多边形、轨迹），支持模型辅助标注。

projects.en: Versions large datasets and models alongside Git and defines reproducible pipelines from data to metrics.
projects.zh: 配合 Git 给大数据集和模型做版本管理，并定义从数据到指标的可复现流水线。

projects.en: Runs language models on hundreds of standard benchmarks with fixed prompts so scores are comparable across papers.
projects.zh: 在数百个标准基准上用固定提示评测语言模型，使不同论文的分数可比。

projects.en: Evaluation platform covering many Chinese and English benchmarks for LLMs and multimodal models.
projects.zh: 覆盖大量中英文基准的大模型和多模态模型评测平台。

projects.en: Framework for writing LLM and agent evaluations with solvers, tools, sandboxes and a log viewer.
projects.zh: 编写大模型和智能体评测的框架，带求解器、工具调用、沙箱和日志查看器。

projects.en: Holistic evaluation of language models over many scenarios and metrics beyond accuracy, with a public leaderboard.
projects.zh: 从多场景、多指标（不只准确率）全面评测语言模型，并有公开排行榜。

projects.en: Fast LLM evaluation across several inference backends, with per-sample results saved for inspection.
projects.zh: 支持多种推理后端的快速大模型评测，保存逐条样本结果便于检查。

projects.en: Post-hoc tests (Nemenyi, Conover, Dunn...) and critical-difference plots for comparing many methods over many datasets.
projects.zh: 提供 Nemenyi、Conover、Dunn 等事后检验和临界差异图，用于在多个数据集上比较多种方法。

projects.en: Significance tests for comparing deep-learning models over seeds, including Almost Stochastic Order and multiple-comparison correction.
projects.zh: 比较多次随机种子下深度学习模型的显著性检验，含 ASO 检验和多重比较校正。

projects.en: Modern typesetting system with simple markup and fast incremental compiles; a growing alternative to LaTeX for papers and theses.
projects.zh: 新一代排版系统，标记简单、增量编译快，正逐渐成为论文和学位论文中 LaTeX 的替代选择。

projects.en: Universal document converter: Markdown, LaTeX, Word, HTML and more, with citeproc for references.
projects.zh: 通用文档转换器：Markdown、LaTeX、Word、HTML 等互转，并支持 citeproc 处理参考文献。

projects.en: Source of the Overleaf collaborative LaTeX editor, so a lab can self-host it (Community Edition).
projects.zh: Overleaf 协作式 LaTeX 编辑器的源码，课题组可以自行部署（社区版）。

projects.en: VS Code extension for LaTeX: build, PDF preview with SyncTeX, autocompletion and linting.
projects.zh: VS Code 的 LaTeX 插件：编译、PDF 预览与正反向跳转、自动补全和检查。

projects.en: Pandoc-based publishing system that turns Markdown/notebooks with live code into PDFs, journal formats and websites.
projects.zh: 基于 Pandoc 的出版系统，把含可运行代码的 Markdown/Notebook 输出为 PDF、期刊格式和网页。

projects.en: Tsinghua University LaTeX thesis template, a model for the many Chinese university thesis templates.
projects.zh: 清华大学 LaTeX 学位论文模板，也是众多国内高校论文模板的代表。

projects.en: Self-contained TeX engine that fetches packages on demand, so papers build reproducibly without a full TeX Live install.
projects.zh: 自包含的 TeX 引擎，按需下载宏包，无需完整安装 TeX Live 也能可复现地编译论文。

projects.en: Desktop LaTeX editor with built-in PDF viewer, completion, and structure view.
projects.zh: 桌面 LaTeX 编辑器，自带 PDF 阅读、补全和文档结构视图。

projects.en: Official LaTeX style files for ACL-family venues (ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, ...).
projects.zh: ACL 系列会议（ACL、EMNLP、NAACL 等）的官方 LaTeX 模板。

projects.en: Curated prompts and workflows for using LLMs to polish, translate and check research papers.
projects.zh: 整理用大模型润色、翻译和检查论文的提示词与流程。

projects.en: Open-source grammar, style and spelling checker for 25+ languages; can run as a local server.
projects.zh: 开源语法、风格和拼写检查器，支持 25 种以上语言，可本地部署为服务。

projects.en: Markup-aware prose linter with configurable style rules (e.g. weasel words, passive voice).
projects.zh: 可识别标记语法的文本检查器，可自定义风格规则（如空泛词、被动语态）。

projects.en: Checklist of common small mistakes in ML/NLP paper writing and submission (Chinese and English).
projects.zh: MLNLP 社区整理的论文写作与投稿常见小错误清单（中英文）。

projects.en: Overleaf plugin with LLM agents that review and suggest edits inside the editor.
projects.zh: Overleaf 插件，用大模型智能体在编辑器内审阅论文并给出修改建议。

projects.en: Formats LaTeX source (indentation, line breaks, one sentence per line) for cleaner diffs and co-authoring.
projects.zh: 格式化 LaTeX 源码（缩进、换行、一句一行），便于对比差异和多人协作。

projects.en: Spelling, grammar and style checks on LaTeX source with errors mapped back to the original lines.
projects.zh: 对 LaTeX 源文件做拼写、语法和风格检查，错误能对应回原始行号。

projects.en: Marks up the differences between two LaTeX versions as a compiled PDF, e.g. for rebuttal 'changes' files.
projects.zh: 把两个 LaTeX 版本的差异标注出来并生成 PDF，常用于返修时提交修改对照稿。

projects.en: Language server that runs LanguageTool on LaTeX and Markdown in your editor, skipping commands and math.
projects.zh: 在编辑器中对 LaTeX 和 Markdown 运行 LanguageTool 的语言服务器，会跳过命令和公式。

projects.en: Whiteboard for quick hand-drawn-style diagrams, often used for teaser and overview figures.
projects.zh: 白板工具，快速画手绘风格示意图，常用于论文首图和概览图。

projects.en: Desktop draw.io for pipeline and system diagrams, exporting vector PDF/SVG.
projects.zh: draw.io 桌面版，画流程图和系统框图，可导出 PDF/SVG 矢量图。

projects.en: LaTeX/TikZ code for drawing CNN-style neural network architecture diagrams.
projects.zh: 用 LaTeX/TikZ 代码绘制 CNN 等神经网络结构图。

projects.en: Open-access book with code on making clear scientific figures in Matplotlib.
projects.zh: 开源的科学可视化书籍，附代码，讲解如何用 Matplotlib 画清晰的科研图。

projects.en: Matplotlib styles for journal and conference figures (IEEE, Nature, high-contrast and colour-blind-safe palettes).
projects.zh: 适用于期刊和会议论文的 Matplotlib 样式（IEEE、Nature、高对比度与色盲友好配色）。

projects.en: Agent pipeline that generates academic method diagrams and plots from a paper's text.
projects.zh: 根据论文文本自动生成方法示意图和统计图的智能体流程。

projects.en: Web tool that draws FCNN, LeNet- and AlexNet-style architecture schematics and exports SVG.
projects.zh: 网页工具，绘制全连接、LeNet 和 AlexNet 风格的网络结构示意图并导出 SVG。

projects.en: Source of PGF/TikZ, the LaTeX graphics language used for most hand-built diagrams in papers (pgfplots lives alongside).
projects.zh: PGF/TikZ 的源码，论文中大多数手绘示意图所用的 LaTeX 绘图语言（pgfplots 在同一组织下）。

projects.en: Draws the actual graph of a PyTorch model (layers, shapes) with Graphviz.
projects.zh: 用 Graphviz 画出 PyTorch 模型的真实计算图（层和张量形状）。

projects.en: Perceptually uniform, colour-blind-friendly colormaps for Matplotlib.
projects.zh: 感知均匀、对色盲友好的 Matplotlib 色图。

projects.en: Strips comments, unused files and oversized images from a LaTeX project so it can be uploaded to arXiv without leaking drafts.
projects.zh: 清理 LaTeX 工程里的注释、未用文件和过大的图片，上传 arXiv 时不会把草稿内容一起公开。

projects.en: Checks an ACL-style PDF for margin overflows, page limits, fonts and paper size, and flags bad references.
projects.zh: 检查 ACL 格式论文 PDF 的越界、页数、字体、纸张大小，并提示参考文献问题。

projects.en: Checks each reference of a paper against Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex and arXiv and reports wrong authors, years, venues or references that do not exist.
projects.zh: 把论文的每条参考文献与 Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex、arXiv 比对，指出作者、年份、会议错误或根本不存在的文献。

projects.en: Uses latexmk's dependency list to collect exactly the files a paper needs into an arXiv-ready archive, including the .bbl.
projects.zh: 按 latexmk 的依赖记录收集论文真正用到的文件（含 .bbl），打包成可直接上传 arXiv 的压缩包。

projects.en: Runs BibTeX verification against Crossref and OpenAlex as a CI step, failing the build on hallucinated or mismatched entries.
projects.zh: 把 BibTeX 与 Crossref、OpenAlex 的核对放进 CI，出现虚构或不匹配的条目就让构建失败。

projects.en: Scans paper LaTeX for common mistakes such as wrong spacing before citations, inconsistent capitalisation and misused abbreviations.
projects.zh: 扫描论文 LaTeX 源码里的常见错误，如引用前的空格、大小写不一致、缩写误用。

projects.en: Community-maintained deadlines of CCF-ranked and other CS conferences, with a website, CLI and WeChat mini-program.
projects.zh: 社区维护的 CCF 推荐及其他计算机会议截稿时间，有网站、命令行和微信小程序。

projects.en: The original AI deadline countdown site that many forks and field-specific trackers copy.
projects.zh: 最早的 AI 截稿倒计时网站，许多分支和各领域的追踪站都由它而来。

projects.en: Serves an anonymised, read-only copy of a GitHub repository for double-blind review, hiding names in files and history.
projects.zh: 为双盲评审提供匿名的只读 GitHub 仓库副本，隐藏文件和历史里的姓名。

projects.en: Deadline countdowns for security and privacy conferences.
projects.zh: 安全与隐私方向会议的截稿倒计时。

projects.en: Self-hosted conference review system for submissions, reviewer assignment, reviews and author responses.
projects.zh: 可自建的会议评审系统，涵盖投稿、分配审稿人、审稿和作者回复。

projects.en: Countdowns to AI conference deadlines, the maintained continuation of the Papers with Code list.
projects.zh: AI 会议截稿倒计时，是 Papers with Code 版本的持续维护版。

projects.en: Official Python client for OpenReview: fetch submissions, reviews and decisions, or script venue workflows.
projects.zh: OpenReview 官方 Python 客户端，可获取投稿、审稿意见和决定，也能脚本化会议流程。

projects.en: Cleaned per-venue lists of submissions with review scores and decisions, collected from OpenReview and other sources.
projects.zh: 按会议整理好的投稿列表，含审稿分数和录用结果，来源于 OpenReview 等。

projects.en: Simulates reviewers, authors and area chairs with LLM agents to study biases in the review process.
projects.zh: 用大模型智能体模拟审稿人、作者和领域主席，研究评审过程中的偏差。

projects.en: Multi-agent system that reads the paper and reviews, plans responses point by point and drafts a rebuttal.
projects.zh: 读入论文和审稿意见，逐条规划回应并起草 rebuttal 的多智能体系统。

projects.en: Agent skill that guides a coding agent through structured rebuttal writing.
projects.zh: 引导编程智能体按结构撰写 rebuttal 的技能包。

projects.en: List: collected advice and examples for writing rebuttals, from the Chinese MLNLP community.
projects.zh: 清单：MLNLP 社区整理的 rebuttal 写作建议和示例。

projects.en: Dataset of papers with peer reviews and accept/reject labels, plus baseline code for review research.
projects.zh: 带审稿意见和录用标签的论文数据集，附研究审稿用的基线代码。

projects.en: Includes DeepReviewer, an open model that writes structured reviews and scores for ML papers.
projects.zh: 包含 DeepReviewer：一个能为机器学习论文写结构化审稿意见和打分的开源模型。

projects.en: LaTeX templates for one-page CVPR/ICCV-style rebuttals with compact layouts.
projects.zh: CVPR/ICCV 风格一页 rebuttal 的 LaTeX 模板，排版紧凑。

projects.en: Editor for writing rebuttals: organise reviewer points, draft answers and keep within length limits.
projects.zh: 写 rebuttal 的编辑器：整理审稿人问题、起草回答并控制篇幅。

projects.en: Computes reviewer-paper affinity scores from reviewers' past papers for the OpenReview matching system.
projects.zh: 根据审稿人以往论文计算审稿人与投稿的匹配分数，供 OpenReview 分配使用。

projects.en: Uploads model weights, datasets and model/dataset cards to the Hugging Face Hub from Python or the command line.
projects.zh: 用 Python 或命令行把模型权重、数据集及其说明卡片上传到 Hugging Face Hub。

projects.en: Guide and README template for releasing ML code, the basis of the NeurIPS code submission checklist.
projects.zh: 发布机器学习代码的指南和 README 模板，NeurIPS 代码提交清单的来源。

projects.en: Powers mybinder.org, letting readers open a paper's notebooks in the browser from a single link.
projects.zh: mybinder.org 的底层，读者点一个链接就能在浏览器里运行论文的 notebook。

projects.en: Builds a runnable container from a repository's requirements or environment files without writing a Dockerfile.
projects.zh: 根据仓库里的依赖或环境文件直接构建可运行的容器，不必写 Dockerfile。

projects.en: Metadata format and tools for describing ML datasets, required for the NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks track.
projects.zh: 描述机器学习数据集的元数据格式和工具，NeurIPS 数据集与基准赛道要求使用。

projects.en: Source of the Open Science Framework for preregistration, project files, preprints and DOIs.
projects.zh: 开放科学框架 OSF 的源码，用于预注册、项目文件、预印本和 DOI。

projects.en: Version-controls and publishes datasets with git-annex and records which command produced each output for re-running.
projects.zh: 基于 git-annex 管理和发布数据集，并记录每个输出由哪条命令生成，方便重跑。

projects.en: Spec for CITATION.cff, which makes GitHub, Zenodo and Zotero show a correct citation for a repository.
projects.zh: CITATION.cff 规范，让 GitHub、Zenodo 和 Zotero 为仓库显示正确的引用格式。

projects.en: Traces a command's run and packs all files and libraries it used into a bundle others can replay.
projects.zh: 追踪一次命令运行，把用到的所有文件和库打包，别人可以原样重放。

projects.en: Source of Zenodo, which archives code, data and artefacts with a DOI and mints one per GitHub release.
projects.zh: Zenodo 的源码；Zenodo 为代码、数据等存档并分配 DOI，可在每次 GitHub 发布时自动生成。

projects.en: GitHub Pages template for a personal academic site with publications, talks, teaching and CV pages.
projects.zh: 个人学术主页的 GitHub Pages 模板，含论文、报告、教学和简历页。

projects.en: Jekyll theme for academics with BibTeX-driven publication lists, project pages, blog and CV.
projects.zh: 面向学者的 Jekyll 主题，用 BibTeX 生成论文列表，带项目页、博客和简历。

projects.en: Fill-in-the-blanks HTML template for a paper's project page with teaser video, abstract, figures, poster and BibTeX.
projects.zh: 填空式的论文项目主页 HTML 模板，含预告视频、摘要、图、海报和 BibTeX。

projects.en: Hugo template (formerly Wowchemy/Hugo Academic) for an academic portfolio with BibTeX import.
projects.zh: Hugo 学术主页模板（原 Wowchemy / Hugo Academic），可导入 BibTeX。

projects.en: The Nerfies project page that most ML paper pages are copied from.
projects.zh: Nerfies 的项目主页，大多数机器学习论文主页都由它改来。

projects.en: Jon Barron's plain HTML homepage, the source of the widely copied one-page researcher layout.
projects.zh: Jon Barron 的纯 HTML 主页，被大量复用的单页研究者主页样式出自这里。

projects.en: Single-page academic homepage template with automatic Google Scholar citation counts.
projects.zh: 单页学术主页模板，可自动显示 Google Scholar 引用数。

projects.en: Jekyll plugin that renders publication lists and citations from BibTeX.
projects.zh: 从 BibTeX 生成论文列表和引用的 Jekyll 插件。

projects.en: Minimal Jekyll theme for an academic homepage with a publication list.
projects.zh: 带论文列表的极简 Jekyll 学术主页主题。

projects.en: GitHub Pages template for an academic homepage with publication data kept in YAML.
projects.zh: 学术主页 GitHub Pages 模板，论文信息存放在 YAML 中。

projects.en: Astro rebuild of the Nerfies page where content is written in Markdown/MDX with components for figures and videos.
projects.zh: 用 Astro 重做的 Nerfies 式主页，内容用 Markdown/MDX 写，有图片和视频组件。

projects.en: Agent skills that turn a paper PDF into a web page, slides, a poster and social posts.
projects.zh: 把论文 PDF 转成网页、幻灯片、海报和社交平台帖子的智能体技能包。

projects.en: Vue-based project page template driven by a config file.
projects.zh: 基于 Vue、由配置文件驱动的项目主页模板。

projects.en: HTML presentation framework used underneath many Markdown and Quarto slide tools.
projects.zh: HTML 演示框架，许多 Markdown 和 Quarto 幻灯片工具都基于它。

projects.en: Markdown slides with live code, LaTeX math and Vue components, exported to PDF.
projects.zh: 用 Markdown 写幻灯片，支持实时代码、LaTeX 公式和 Vue 组件，可导出 PDF。

projects.en: Writes slides in plain Markdown and exports them to PDF, HTML or PowerPoint.
projects.zh: 用纯 Markdown 写幻灯片，导出 PDF、HTML 或 PowerPoint。

projects.en: Metropolis, a clean modern Beamer theme.
projects.zh: Metropolis：简洁现代的 Beamer 主题。

projects.en: Multi-agent system that generates an editable poster from a paper PDF.
projects.zh: 从论文 PDF 自动生成可编辑海报的多智能体系统。

projects.en: Generates a slide deck from a paper in one step.
projects.zh: 一步把论文生成幻灯片。

projects.en: Slide framework for Typst with themes and animations, compiling much faster than Beamer.
projects.zh: Typst 的幻灯片框架，有主题和动画，编译比 Beamer 快得多。

projects.en: Generates a presentation video with slides, subtitles and a talking presenter from a paper.
projects.zh: 从论文生成带幻灯片、字幕和讲者形象的报告视频。

projects.en: List: screenshots and links of community Beamer themes, including many university themes.
projects.zh: 清单：社区 Beamer 主题的截图和链接，含许多高校主题。

projects.en: The Beamer LaTeX class for slides, the default for math-heavy talks.
projects.zh: Beamer 幻灯片 LaTeX 文档类，公式多的报告的默认选择。

projects.en: Clean beamerposter theme for LaTeX conference posters.
projects.zh: 简洁的 LaTeX beamerposter 会议海报主题。

projects.en: Writes conference posters in R Markdown and renders them to PDF through HTML.
projects.zh: 用 R Markdown 写会议海报，经 HTML 渲染为 PDF。

projects.en: Builds a poster as one HTML/CSS file and prints it to a PDF of the right size with a headless browser.
projects.zh: 把海报写成一个 HTML/CSS 文件，再用无头浏览器输出尺寸正确的 PDF。

projects.en: The beamerposter package that lets Beamer themes be used for large-format posters.
projects.zh: 让 Beamer 主题可用于大幅海报的 beamerposter 宏包。

projects.en: LaTeX version of Mike Morrison's #betterposter layout with one large central finding.
projects.zh: Mike Morrison #betterposter 版式的 LaTeX 模板，中间放一句核心结论。

projects.en: Typst package for scientific posters with themes and layout boxes.
projects.zh: 用 Typst 做科研海报的宏包，带主题和版块布局。

projects.en: Research code that turns a paper into platform-specific promotion posts and evaluates them.
projects.zh: 把论文转成适合各社交平台的推广帖并评估效果的研究代码。

projects.en: Browser extension that watches Google Scholar citation counts and notes changes.
projects.zh: 监视 Google Scholar 引用数变化的浏览器扩展。

projects.en: Builds course notes and books from Markdown and notebooks, with executable code.
projects.zh: 用 Markdown 和 Notebook 构建课程讲义和书，代码可执行。

projects.en: Server behind Hypothesis web annotation, letting a reading group annotate papers together in private groups.
projects.zh: Hypothesis 网页批注的服务端，读书会可以在私有小组里一起批注论文。

projects.en: Creates, distributes and grades notebook assignments.
projects.zh: 创建、分发并批改 Notebook 作业。

projects.en: Jekyll lab website template that builds the publication list automatically from DOIs, ORCID and other identifiers.
projects.zh: Jekyll 课题组网站模板，可根据 DOI、ORCID 等标识自动生成论文列表。

projects.en: Hugo template for a research group site with people, publications, news and events.
projects.zh: 研究组网站的 Hugo 模板，含成员、论文、新闻和活动。

gaps.en: Rank the daily feed by signs that a paper will matter: accepted venue, released code, early citations.
gaps.zh: 按论文可能的影响给每日推荐排序：是否被会议接收、有没有开源代码、早期引用。
gaps.missing_en: Recommenders score closeness to your topics only.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有推荐只按与你研究方向的相似度打分。

gaps.en: See why a paper is cited (uses it, compares with it, disputes it) and which later results beat it.
gaps.zh: 看到一篇论文为什么被引用（使用、对比还是反驳），以及后来哪些结果超过了它。
gaps.missing_en: Open tools show who cites whom, not how; citation intent is only in paid services.
gaps.missing_zh: 开源工具只显示谁引用了谁，不显示怎么引用的；引用意图只有付费服务提供。

gaps.en: Find references in a .bib file that do not exist or have wrong metadata, and update preprints to their published versions.
gaps.zh: 找出 .bib 里不存在或信息有误的参考文献，并把预印本更新为正式发表的版本。
gaps.missing_en: rebiber matches only DBLP and the ACL Anthology; betterbib does not flag entries that match nothing.
gaps.missing_zh: rebiber 只对照 DBLP 和 ACL Anthology；betterbib 不会标出查无此文的条目。

gaps.en: Translate a paper from its LaTeX source, keeping formulas, references and figures exact.
gaps.zh: 从 LaTeX 源码翻译论文，公式、引用和图都保持原样。
gaps.missing_en: Translators work from the PDF and still break on dense formulas and tables.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有翻译工具基于 PDF 版面，遇到密集的公式和表格仍会出错。

gaps.en: Check that each citation in an AI-written review actually supports the sentence it is attached to.
gaps.zh: 检查 AI 写的综述里，每条引用是否真的支持它所在的那句话。
gaps.missing_en: Research agents attach citations while writing but never check a finished draft.
gaps.missing_zh: 科研智能体在生成时附上引用，但不会回头核对已有文稿。

gaps.en: Check a research idea for novelty against prior work, showing the overlapping papers.
gaps.zh: 检查一个研究想法是否新颖，并列出与之重叠的已有论文。
gaps.missing_en: Existing novelty steps are a few search queries judged by a language model.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有的新颖性检查只是几次检索加大模型判断。

gaps.en: Know whether a benchmark score in a paper is comparable to yours: same harness, prompts, shots, decoding.
gaps.zh: 判断论文里的基准分数能否与你的直接比较：评测框架、提示词、样例数、解码设置是否一致。
gaps.missing_en: Each harness gives different numbers for one task, and papers rarely state their settings.
gaps.missing_zh: 不同评测框架对同一任务给出的分数不同，论文又很少写明设置。

gaps.en: Share a small lab's few GPU machines fairly, with a job queue, without running Slurm.
gaps.zh: 小课题组几台 GPU 机器的公平共享与排队，不用部署 Slurm。
gaps.missing_en: Slurm needs an administrator; GPU monitors only show who is using a card.
gaps.missing_zh: Slurm 需要专人维护；GPU 监控工具只能看到谁在用卡。

gaps.en: Move a paper between venue templates (or from LaTeX to Typst) with a report of what breaks.
gaps.zh: 在不同会议模板之间（或从 LaTeX 到 Typst）迁移论文，并报告哪里出了问题。
gaps.missing_en: Pandoc loses custom macros and venue environments; nothing knows page limits or style-file quirks.
gaps.missing_zh: Pandoc 会丢掉自定义宏和会议专用环境；没有工具了解页数限制和模板细节。

gaps.en: Style checking for academic writing that understands LaTeX math and works offline.
gaps.zh: 能理解 LaTeX 数学公式、可离线运行的学术写作风格检查。
gaps.missing_en: General rules give many false alarms on math-heavy text; academic rule sets must be written by hand.
gaps.missing_zh: 通用规则在公式多的文本上误报很多；学术写作规则要自己编写。

gaps.en: Editable, paper-style architecture diagrams generated from model code, beyond CNN layer stacks.
gaps.zh: 从模型代码生成可编辑、适合放进论文的结构图，不限于卷积网络的层堆叠。
gaps.missing_en: PlotNeuralNet is hand-written TikZ for CNNs; torchview draws graphs too detailed for a paper.
gaps.missing_zh: PlotNeuralNet 要手写 TikZ 且只适合卷积网络；torchview 画出的计算图对论文来说过于细碎。

gaps.en: A deadline tracker that also keeps each venue's rules: page limits, supplementary deadline, rebuttal window, LLM policy.
gaps.zh: 截稿日期追踪同时记录各会议的规则：页数限制、补充材料截止、rebuttal 时间、大模型使用政策。
gaps.missing_en: Trackers store dates and links only; the rules sit in each year's call for papers.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有追踪只记日期和链接；规则散落在每年的征稿通知里。

gaps.en: Help for reviewers that runs locally: check a submission's references, tables and claims without uploading it.
gaps.zh: 在本地运行的审稿辅助：检查投稿的参考文献、表格和结论，不上传稿件。
gaps.missing_en: Review generators write whole reviews (most venues forbid that) and call hosted models. paper-proof --review checks a PDF locally (consistency, numbers in sentences, references on request), but a PDF's tables cannot be compared with its claims.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有工具直接生成整篇审稿意见（多数会议禁止），而且调用在线模型。paper-proof --review 可在本地检查 PDF（一致性、句子里的数字，需要时查参考文献），但 PDF 里的表格无法与正文结论对照。

gaps.en: Track a rebuttal point by point: status, the experiment each point needs, character limits, score changes.
gaps.zh: 逐条跟踪 rebuttal：每条意见的处理状态、需要补的实验、字数限制、分数变化。
gaps.missing_en: Rebuttal tools draft text; none keeps a tracker tied to the review threads.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有 rebuttal 工具只帮忙写文字，不提供与审稿意见对应的跟踪表。

gaps.en: One release step that keeps the code tag, weights, dataset, citation file and DOI in step.
gaps.zh: 一步完成发布，让代码标签、模型权重、数据集、引用文件和 DOI 保持一致。
gaps.missing_en: Each tool covers one artefact; versions drift between GitHub, Zenodo and the Hugging Face Hub.
gaps.missing_zh: 每个工具只管一样东西，GitHub、Zenodo 和 Hugging Face 之间的版本容易对不上。

gaps.en: An open index linking papers to their code and results, now that Papers with Code has shut down (2025).
gaps.zh: Papers with Code 于 2025 年关闭后，一个把论文与代码和结果关联起来的开放索引。
gaps.missing_en: Hugging Face paper pages are not an open, self-hostable index of results.
gaps.missing_zh: Hugging Face 的论文页面不是开放、可自建的结果索引。

gaps.en: A free alert of who cited your paper and what they said about it.
gaps.zh: 免费提醒：谁引用了你的论文，以及他们是怎么说的。
gaps.missing_en: Trackers give counts; scraping Google Scholar breaks when it is blocked.
gaps.missing_zh: 现有工具只给引用数；抓取 Google Scholar 的方法常被封锁而失效。

gaps.en: Run a reading group in one self-hosted place: suggestions and votes, presenters, schedule, shared notes.
gaps.zh: 在一个可自建的地方组织读书会：推荐与投票、主讲轮换、日程、共享笔记。
gaps.missing_en: Each tool covers one piece; groups still glue spreadsheets and chats together.
gaps.missing_zh: 每个工具只覆盖一部分，读书会仍靠表格和聊天群拼凑。
